verdict.rationale: Collecting user feedback attached to an error event is a fair question for a crash-reporting product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a crash-report dialog, feedback widget, or any way to attach user comments to an error occurrence. The comment feature in raygun-docs-6 is for team members posting AI chat links, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit, and RUM's 'see what your users see' is not user feedback collection.

support.subject: As a developer, I can collect user feedback — a crash-report dialog or feedback widget — attached to the exact error event the user hit
